description: Everything an AI agent is allowed to know about a stored credential. Metadata only — by design there is no field that can hold the secret value.

id.description: Opaque reference. The agent relays this; it reveals nothing about the value.

label.description: User-chosen label, e.g. an account name or 'work account'. Never the secret itself.

origin.description: Exact HTTPS origin the credential may be released to.

title: CredentialReference
